observed: A crowded floor fills the view, with repeated posts, a long screen wall, the bell and podium, whiteboards and elevator doors.
Four groups of fine blank caption lines sit in the corners and a slim search field sits near the top centre.
A narrow drawer shape sits along the right side containing a picture, a note and a receipt.
The world dominates the image; the interface occupies the paper at its edges.
corrections: The drawer is a flat paper interface panel beside the selected station, not the physical wooden drawer drawn here.
Show the selected agent's screen in the drawer rather than the image of a whole post; selection must be explicit without covering the station.
Vary neighbouring posts and stations instead of copying the near-identical repeated posts.
Replace quote-board tables with emblems and single brass price lines; words and readouts belong in the interface.
Do not adopt the image's search radius, typography, spacing, projection or decorative brass as Atlas values.

Colour audit 13 October: replace coloured numerical screen rows with brass line/scale instruments, correct decorative gold drawer hardware, and render the drawer as an interface paper surface. Placeholder caption strokes do not prove ink or muted-text contrast.
